meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Behavior-preserving restructuring of code that is NOT in your current diff — extract modules, rename across files, untangle abstractions, pay down tech debt. For tightening just-changed code use `/zero-tech-debt` instead. Triggers "refactor X", "reorganize this module", "restructure", "extract Y from Z", "pay down tech debt".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构既有代码，提取模块并偿还技术债务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望在不改变行为的前提下改善代码结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, extract modules, and pay down tech debt
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve code structure without changing behavior

howto.what: 当你要求重构代码时，Claude会自动协调多个子助手完成分析、规划、实现、测试和审查，最终输出一份包含变更内容、文件列表、测试结果和改进建议的摘要。
howto.when: 当你提到“重构”、“重组”、“提取”等代码重构关键词，且操作的不是你当前正在编辑的代码时触发。

say.note: Claude将分析并重新组织代码模块。

say.text: 从函数A中提取工具函数
say.note: Claude会提取并封装独立功能。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to refactor code, it orchestrates multiple sub-agents to explore, plan, implement, test, and review, then outputs a summary of changes, files, test status, and improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "refactor", "reorganize", "extract" for code that is not in your current diff.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and reorganize the code module.

say_en.text: Extract utility functions from function A
say_en.note: Claude will isolate and encapsulate independent functionality.
